# AI Platform OpenAPI

Base URL: https://sigrunai.com
API prefix: /v1
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API Key>

## Docs

- [Quickstart](/zh/index.mdx)
- [Introduction](/zh/api-reference/introduction.mdx)
- [Model catalog](/zh/api-reference/common/model-catalog.mdx): GET /v1/model/catalog
- [Upload file](/zh/api-reference/common/files-upload.mdx): POST /v1/files
- [User balance](/zh/api-reference/common/user-balance.mdx): GET /v1/user/balance
- [Key balance](/zh/api-reference/common/key-balance.mdx): GET /v1/key/balance
- [Balance webhook](/zh/api-reference/common/balance-webhook.mdx)
- [Create image](/zh/api-reference/images/create.mdx): POST /v1/images (gpt-image-2)
- [Query image](/zh/api-reference/images/query.mdx): GET /v1/images/{task_id}
- [Query video](/zh/api-reference/common/query.mdx): GET /v1/videos/{task_id}
- [Omni 10s](/zh/api-reference/gemini-omni/create.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model omni-10s
- [Seedance 2.0 MD](/zh/api-reference/seedance/md/create.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model seedance2.0-md
- [Seedance 2.0 AC](/zh/api-reference/seedance/20/create-ac.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model sd2-480p-ac / sd2-720p-ac
- [Seedance 2.0 DL](/zh/api-reference/seedance/20/create-dl.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model sd2-720p-dl
- [Seedance 2.5 30s](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-30s.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model seedance2.5-30s
- [Seedance 2.5 720p AC](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-720p-ac.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model sd2.5-720p-ac
